title: The Most Controversial Idea In Physics
description:
I've wanted to make this video for almost 10 years. I am so happy to finally have this out. This is a video about cosmological fine tuning.

A MASSIVE thank you to Geraint Lewis for his time, the interview, writing the book, and being so supportive of Veritasium, me, and SciComm over the past decade. All of the good parts of the video are his, all the mistakes are mine.

Thanks to Derek Muller for the chats about the intro! You're a legend.

Buy his books! https://www.geraintflewis.com

My Patreon -- https://www.patreon.com/c/SciencePetr

Books!
A Fortunate Universe By Geraint Lewis and Luke Barnes
Just Six Numbers by Martin Rees
The Anthropic Cosmological Principle by John Barrow and Frank Tipler

The Steve Mould Video! It's SO GOOD. I love Steve's work so much -- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=70-_GBymrck


References -- https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EVUpDGxeGRI1cSpaB3wo7psZndfae-2b61EvP_sy5Ko/edit?tab=t.0

Illustrations by Raphaël Aubry
Edited by Trenton Oliver
Assistant editor Yan Zhang
